title: A tester turned an old draft into seven RED images — then changed one file and six checksums stayed identical
titleZh: 实测者把旧稿变成小红书一整套图文：只改一张图，其余六张校验值完全一致
summary: A TMTPost reviewer gave a ChatGPT dot an old draft and asked for a full set of Xiaohongshu (RED) copy and images. It delivered seven images, copy text, a Word package and a zip archive. When he then asked to revise only the fourth image, the other six files' checksums were identical, and the copy and Word file changed only in the specified places.
summaryZh: 钛媒体一位实测者把一份旧稿交给 ChatGPT dot，要求改成一整套小红书文案与配图。它交付了七张配图、可复制的文案、Word 发布包和完整压缩包。随后他要求只修改第四张图，结果其余六张文件的校验值完全一致，文案与 Word 也只改了指定位置。
background: Iterative asset revision is where generative tools usually fail: ask for one change and everything downstream drifts. The test was whether a partial edit could be genuinely partial.
backgroundZh: 「迭代修改素材」是生成式工具通常翻车的地方：改一处，下游全都变。这次实测要验证的是：局部修改能否真的只改局部。

actions.label: Deliverable
actions.value: 7 images, copy text, a Word release package and a zip

actions.label: Verification
actions.value: The other 6 files' checksums were identical

outcome: Non-targeted files were byte-identical after a partial revision, which is the property that makes an asset pipeline usable.
outcomeZh: 局部修改后，非目标文件字节完全一致——这正是让素材流水线可用的关键性质。
caveat: Two details circulating alongside this case are not in the original: the copy length (about 600 characters) and a six-stage image sequence (work scenario to judgment criteria). The checksum comparison was performed by the author using Codex, not by the dot itself.
caveatZh: 与该案例一起流传的两个细节在原文中没有：「文案约 600 字」和那套六段式配图序列（工作场景→判断标准）。另外，校验值比对是作者用 Codex 完成的，并非 dot 自身所为。
keyFact: In an October 2026 hands-on test, a ChatGPT dot converted an old draft into seven RED-format images plus copy, a Word package and a zip, and when only image four was revised the other six files' checksums remained identical.
keyFactZh: 2026 年 10 月的一次实测中，ChatGPT dot 把一份旧稿转成七张小红书配图及文案、Word 包与压缩包；当只修改第四张图时，其余六张文件的校验值保持完全一致。
